# Source

These skills are vendored from Matt Pocock's skills repository.

- Repository: https://github.com/mattpocock/skills
- Pinned commit: `c55ee46073ed923f86ce59a5eb3b6d895095d1b7`
- Included: only the skills this kit uses, from `skills/engineering/` and `skills/productivity/`, flattened into this directory.
  To add another one, copy its folder from upstream at the pinned commit and add its name to `skills.txt`.
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE` in this directory.

Files are byte-identical to upstream at the pinned commit.
To update, check out a newer commit upstream, review the diff, recopy the folders, and update the commit above.
